dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.intro: Discover Slovenia AI uses the following data sources to bring you reliable information about Slovenian tourist destinations.

osm.desc: POI data (points of interest) — attractions, museums, restaurants, hotels, viewpoints, natural landmarks, religious sites. Licence: ODbL.

wikipedia.desc: Descriptions of destinations and POIs. Licence: CC BY-SA.

openMeteo.desc: Real-time weather data. Free API with no key required.

zai.desc: OPTIONAL layer for image understanding (Issue #9 ZERO-AI): reads text/names from screenshots for trip import and reservation confirmations. The platform core (planner, search, chat, guides) is 100% deterministic — 0 AI tokens.

sloveniaInfo.desc: Official tourism content from I feel Slovenia (Slovenian Tourist Board) — 664 structured sources from the slovenia.info llms.txt index, used by the AI as grounded answer context with citations. Updated: September 2026.

dataSources.supplyIntro: Each provider's status is derived directly from our provider registry — a single source of truth that also powers the supply map. Our honesty principle: a partner link is NOT inventory — live offers (prices, availability) appear only once API access is actually approved and connected.
dataSources.prodLegend: Live data: the provider's data actually flows into our system. Configured: access is set up, live verification is still pending. Not configured: self-serve access exists, but the key has not been entered yet. Partner approval required: the API requires an application/contract with the provider. Affiliate link only: the source has no inventory API — a link is NOT inventory.
dataSources.providersText: Details about local providers (hotels, restaurants, activities, products, experiences) are contributed by registered providers through the B2B portal. Each provider is responsible for the accuracy of their own details.

meta.title: Data sources
meta.description: The list of data sources used by the Discover Slovenia AI platform.

dataSources.capabilityIntro: A formalization of each provider's state per the §5 matrix: discovery, affiliate, API search, quote, booking, cancellation, webhook, refund, credentials and E2E evidence. A “live” status means an actual live provider response — published “from” prices are NOT live quotes, a user's document import is NOT a provider confirmation. The matrix derives from the same registry that powers the supply map (no manual upkeep).
dataSources.capabilityLegend: live = actual live source response · coded, awaiting access = adapter wired, empty without credentials/approval · architecture (0 live) = state machine/channel exists, zero live calls · user-attested = manual entry/document import (the document is the attestation) · not supported = the source lacks this capability · not applicable = meaningless for this source · E2E not run = browser proof not yet performed
